## A. About you & credibility

### Q: "Tell me a bit about your background."

> "I've spent the last several years building internal tools — the software a
> business runs on day to day. About a year ago I went independent, and now I
> focus specifically on intake and workflow automation."

### Q: "Have you worked in our industry before?"

*Even if no:*

> "I've worked a lot with CRM-type workflows, which is the same shape of
> problem regardless of the industry. Before any project, I study your
> current processes in detail so the solution fits how you already work."

## B. How you work

### Q: "Walk me through how a project typically works."

> "I start with a current-state review to understand what actually happens
> today. Then I send a proposal with a fixed scope and milestones. You see
> work at each milestone and only release payment once that milestone is
> accepted. Communication is async by default — Slack or email — with a
> weekly sync call."
